title: The drones were orbs from the sea, now over Europe

tellings.quote: These drones supposedly drones that show up. Those aren't drones.

plain: The mysterious 'drones' reported in the skies of the United States in 2024 were not drones at all but orbs that came out of the sea, and the same things are now showing up over Europe. That is what Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs, tells Michels from his own experience. 'Those aren't drones,' he says, which would mean the widely reported sightings were something not made by people.
